newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL TIN HITS 7-MONTH HIGH AT 14.86 RGT/KG.
newsitem.headline: KL TIN HITS 7-MONTH HIGH AT 14.86 RGT/KG.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rose 16 cents to a new seven-month high of 14.86 ringgit ($5.36) a kg on Tuesday as players remained bullish about the weakness of the ringgit against the U.S. dollar.
"The currency is still the factor in today's play," said a trader. "I think the price can go up if the ringgit falls further."
The ringgit touched a new 42-month low against the dollar on Tuesday, falling as low as 2.7930 before recovering to 2.7710.
Traders said the closing price of Malaysian tin on Tuesday was at par with the overnight price on the London Metal Exchange, which closed lower on Monday.
At the opening, there were bids for 275 tonnes against a sales offer of 90 tonnes.
Final turnover was 165 tonnes, from 179 on Monday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
Traders said the next resistance for the market was 15 ringgit.
"There was good buying right at the opening by Europeans, Japanese and locals," said a trader, adding that initial volume was heavy.
